antes.Fees: The desk's fee on the gross premium of each weekly call the vault sells (20% at launch), fixed at the sale and recognized one hour later when the Safe can no longer void the sale; a voided sale charges no fee. The premium itself is not counted as fees: it is the buyer's payment for the option, which depositors carry against the risk of the call settling in the money (see the options adapter's premium volume). A call sold outside the desk (not possible with the current operator) counts the fee the operator reports at settlement.
antes.Revenue: All of the desk fee on the gross premium of each weekly call the vault sells, paid to the HedgeHood treasury Safe at settlement.
antes.ProtocolRevenue: All of the desk fee on the gross premium of each weekly call the vault sells, paid to the HedgeHood treasury Safe at settlement.

despues.Fees: The protocol's fee on the gross premium of each option the vaults sell (20% at launch). v1 vault (NVDA Printer): fixed at the sale and recognized one hour later when the Safe can no longer void the sale; a voided sale charges no fee; a call sold outside the desk (not possible with the current operator) counts the fee the operator reports at settlement. v2 and v2.1 funds (Robinhood Chain and BNB Chain): the premium stays escrowed in the fund until the epoch settles, so the fee is counted at settlement, as the fund reports it (EpochSettled.fee); voided positions and unpriced settlements charge none. despues.Fees: Transaction fees paid by users for executing transactions on Sonic.

despues.ProtocolRevenue: Sonic keeps no gas fees.

despues.HoldersRevenue: Gas fees burned: the SFC burntFeeShare (0 until 2025-12-12, 5% since), plus from 2025-12-16 the burned half of the FeeM residual.

despues.Fees: Transaction fees paid by users on Ronin, in RON.
despues.Revenue: From the 2026-05-12 hard fork (16:00 UTC) into an OP Stack rollup: transaction fees minus the ETH Ronin pays on Ethereum to post batches and propose state roots. EigenDA is paid off Ethereum and is not deducted. Before the hard fork, revenue is reported as all transaction fees, unchanged from the previous adapter; the sidechain-era validator share is not split out.
despues.ProtocolRevenue: Net sequencer revenue, which goes to the Ronin treasury, from the 2026-05-12 hard fork.
despues.SupplySideRevenue: ETH paid on Ethereum by the Ronin batcher to post batches and by the proposer to create and resolve dispute games, from the 2026-05-12 hard fork.

antes.Fees: Transaction fees paid by users for executing transactions on the Cosmos network
antes.Revenue: No revenue
antes.SupplySideRevenue: All the transaction fees are distributed to validators
antes.HoldersRevenue: None of the transaction fees are burnt

despues.Fees: Transaction fees paid by users for executing transactions on the Cosmos network, including the tip paid to the block proposer
despues.Revenue: Transaction fees not paid to validators: before Gaia v18 the community tax share sent to the community pool, since v18 (July 2024) the base fee locked in the feemarket-fee-collector module account
despues.ProtocolRevenue: Before Gaia v18 (July 2024) the community tax share of transaction fees went to the community pool: 2% until December 19, 2022, 10% after (prop 88). Since v18 fees no longer pass through the community tax
despues.SupplySideRevenue: Before Gaia v18 transaction fees minus the community tax went to validators and delegators, since v18 only the tip above the base fee goes to the block proposer
despues.HoldersRevenue: Since Gaia v18 (July 2024) the base fee of every tx, and since v19.1 (August 2024) the whole fee of failed txs, is locked in the feemarket-fee-collector module account (distribute_fees = false), a soft burn that takes it out of circulation without reducing total supply

antes.Fees: All transaction (gas) fees paid by users on the NEAR blockchain, fetched from Allium.
antes.Revenue: 70% of every gas fee is permanently burned, reducing NEAR supply. The other 30% is paid to contract developers, so only 70% is protocol revenue.
antes.SupplySideRevenue: The remaining 30% of each gas fee is rebated to the developer of the smart contract being called.
antes.HoldersRevenue: Burned gas fees (70%) accrue to all NEAR holders through reduced circulating supply.

despues.Fees: All transaction (gas) fees paid by users on the NEAR blockchain, fetched from Allium.
despues.Revenue: Gas fees permanently burned, reducing NEAR supply. Before 4 November 2026 (protocol upgrade v87) the burn is estimated at 70% of fees, the rest went to contract developers; since then 100% of gas fees are burned.
despues.SupplySideRevenue: Gas rewards rebated to the developer of the called contract, estimated at 30% of fees before 4 November 2026. Protocol upgrade v87 removed developer gas rewards, so this is 0 since then.
despues.HoldersRevenue: Burned gas fees accrue to all NEAR holders through reduced supply: an estimated 70% of fees before 4 November 2026 (protocol upgrade v87), 100% since then.

antes.Fees: All transaction fees paid by users on the Algorand blockchain
antes.Revenue: All transaction fees on Algorand are burned, effectively benefiting all ALGO holders through reduced supply

despues.Fees: All transaction fees paid by users on the Algorand blockchain
despues.Revenue: Transaction fees kept in the fee sink, the protocol account all fees are paid to. Algorand does not burn fees.
despues.ProtocolRevenue: Transaction fees kept in the fee sink, a protocol account whose spending is restricted by consensus rules.
despues.SupplySideRevenue: Since the 2025-01-23 consensus upgrade, eligible block proposers are paid 50% of their block's fees out of the fee sink. Proposer bonuses are not fees and are excluded.
despues.HoldersRevenue: No transaction fees are burned or distributed to ALGO holders.

antes.Fees: Trading fees StonkFun collects, measured when it claims them: the 1% platform fee on its Raydium LaunchLab bonding curves (every platform config whose fees it claims), the creator fee on the Raydium CPMM pools those launches graduate into, and the quote side of fees harvested from the permanently locked liquidity behind pre-LaunchLab launches. Raydium's own fee shares are excluded. Each token is valued with Dune trade prices at the hour it was received, ignoring trades priced more than 10x away from that day's median.
antes.Revenue: Fees less the creator share of standard launches and the flywheel share of reward launches, as paid out on-chain. From 2026-08-28, fees paid in STONK and fees from STONK's own pool are excluded: they cannot fund a STONK buyback.
antes.ProtocolRevenue: Fees StonkFun keeps after paying the creator share of standard launches and the flywheel share of reward launches, minus the quote assets spent buying STONK on Jupiter. From 2026-08-28, fees paid in STONK and fees from STONK's own pool are excluded. Buybacks spend income claimed on earlier days, so this is negative when a buyback is larger than the day's retained fees.
antes.SupplySideRevenue: Creator and flywheel shares of fees, measured when they are paid out.
antes.HoldersRevenue: Quote assets spent buying STONK on Jupiter, identified on-chain as swaps that returned STONK to the operator wallet, at the net amount each swap spent.
